title: What If All the Ice on Earth Melted?

scenes.text: What if every glacier and ice sheet melted? Your map of Earth would be wrong.
Sea level would rise about 216 feet, roughly 65 meters. Taller than a twenty-story building.
The Atlantic coast of the United States, Florida and the Gulf Coast would go under. So would London and Venice.
All of Bangladesh would flood. In Asia alone, hundreds of millions of people would be displaced.
The average temperature of Earth would climb from about 58 degrees Fahrenheit to roughly 80.
But relax a little. Melting that much ice would take more than 5,000 years. The map redraws slowly.

description:
